earth_worker.description: Bounded implementation after interfaces are fixed

earth_reviewer.description: Independent correctness review; no source edits

earth_validator.description: Reproducible verification and assigned test fixtures

phases.requires: No prior handoff. Git available; network access to the public source repository.

tasks.assignment: Run/inspect the bootstrap, create only the isolated source checkout if absent, and report the revision, branch, status and supported environment requirements. Own setup operations; do not edit production code.
In parallel, read the package design and source references. Identify phase dependencies and missing preflight facts. Do not touch the checkout while it is being created.
After setup finishes, independently inspect isolation, revision and proposed test commands. Verify the handoff evidence without installing the mod or starting the game.

phases.requires: Handoff 00 complete; isolated source checkout and supported Python environment available.

tasks.assignment: Inspect existing tests, diagnostics and profiling; return exact entry points and the smallest representative fixtures. Read-only.
After the lead fixes measurement boundaries, implement assigned instrumentation and benchmark hooks. Own only the named production/diagnostic files.
Own separate benchmark fixtures and result validation. After instrumentation stabilizes, run comparisons and check overhead independently; avoid overlapping benchmark runs.

phases.requires: Handoff 01 complete with baseline fixtures and current tests understood.

tasks.assignment: Trace terrain/road preparation, ownership and cache dependencies. Return a focused code map and current invariants. Read-only.
After the lead freezes the shared plan/cache contract, own the common terrain path and artifact implementation plus explicitly assigned regression tests.

Review the proposed contract before edits, then independently review the stable implementation for seams, partial DEM upgrades, invalidation, anchor transforms and navigation support. Report actionable findings.

phases.requires: Handoff 02 complete; stable world-plan/artifact IDs and parity tests exist.

tasks.assignment: Trace worker reservations, backpressure, protocol IDs and release acknowledgments. Identify dependency boundaries and failure cases. Read-only.
After contract agreement, own assigned scheduling/cancellation/activation changes. Shared protocol and Lua changes are a single coordinated workstream.
Challenge starvation, stale completion, duplicate messages, bridge support and resource release. Review the stable patch independently and supply reproducing cases; no source edits.

phases.requires: Handoff 03 complete; normalized facts and artifact invalidation contracts available.

tasks.assignment: Verify schemas, source versions, access paths and license evidence; propose normalization mappings with explicit missing-data semantics. Read-only.
After the lead freezes provider contracts, own GLC_FCS10 preparation/lookup, its fallback and disjoint tests.
In parallel with vegetation, own SoilGrids/JRC preparation and lookup plus disjoint tests. Do not edit the vegetation worker's or lead's shared files.
After implementation workers release their slots, independently check regional-provider-disabled output, units/CRS/no-data, provenance and runtime cost.

phases.requires: Handoff 04 complete; source/artifact contract stable; saved credential available. Download authentication may need separate OAuth support.

tasks.assignment: Research a bounded category shortlist and model/API/license metadata without credentials. Return verifiable candidates and eligibility uncertainties; do not download models.
After the lead fixes manifest/auth/conversion interfaces, own the downloader/preparation/catalog implementation. Use credentials only through the local helpers; serialize actual Blender mutations.

Independently inspect archive safety, transforms, output budgets, attribution and failure behavior. Use fixtures first and only run conversion checks on an isolated scene after the writer is finished.

phases.requires: Handoffs 04 and 05 complete; approved prepared catalog and normalized facts available.

tasks.assignment: Map normalized facts to catalog categories, data gaps and conservative placement/exclusion rules. Read-only; distinguish observed objects from inferred decoration.
After the lead freezes rule/transform/ownership contracts, own deterministic matching, compiled placements and assigned engine integration files.
Review road clearances, seams, landmarks, rebase transforms, LOD/resource budgets and missing-model fallback independently on the stable implementation.

phases.requires: Handoffs 01–06 complete or explicitly marked with unresolved work; no release claim while required gates remain pending.

tasks.assignment: Read-only audit of geometry, cache invalidation, collision/navigation compatibility and streaming lifecycle against the pinned baseline and phase handoffs.
Independently audit data/model licensing evidence, source versions, attribution, secret exclusion, bounded downloads and fallback completeness. Read-only.
Run the agreed regression and reproducible benchmark plan on a stable revision; own only test reports/artifacts. Serialize engine use and heavy benchmarks. Re-check any fixes.
